reasons: The trusted inherited recipe passed 31/31 nodes on iOS.
Badge, placeholder, signed-trigger, and validation claims use explicit waits before screenshots.
Open-position PnL cases and the positive-SL maximum boundary are covered by focused hook and utility tests.
The graph starts from metamask.perps.start_state, uses manifest-declared actions, and has no unconditional pass.
better_version_guidance: When the prepared mobile bridge is available, rerun the inherited recipe and add a controllable live open-position case if the fixture supports one.

coverage.reason: All derived ACs have inherited recipe evidence or focused unit coverage.

graph.reason: The inherited graph starts from a deterministic Perps state and terminates only after its assertions.

evidence.reason: The latest valid family package records screenshot evidence for every visual claim.

assertions.reason: Test-ID and text waits fail when badges, placeholders, or validation errors are absent.

flakeRisk.reason: The recipe uses state-based waits and no fixed sleeps.

contextual_findings.message: Current-run recipe execution was skipped because the prepared iOS app did not expose the automation bridge.
